morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为疾病名称使用，无现代马来语词缀。本条未列出未经核实的派生词；penyakit kusta、pesakit kusta 属于短语搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 麻风病，又称汉森病；一种主要由麻风分枝杆菌引起、主要影响皮肤与周围神经的慢性传染病。
senses.en_definition: Leprosy, or Hansen disease: a chronic infectious disease caused mainly by Mycobacterium leprae, primarily affecting the skin and peripheral nerves.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis penyakit yang boleh merosakkan kulit dan anggota badan serta menyebabkan kecacatan.
senses.nuances: 马来语释义概括 DBP 词条；中英释义补充现代医学表述。不能把溃烂、化脓或肢体损伤理解为所有患者必然出现的表现。该病可以治愈。[DBP：kusta](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=kusta)；[WHO：Leprosy](https://www.who.int/en/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/leprosy)

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Kempen kesedaran itu menekankan bahawa kusta boleh disembuhkan dan pesakit perlu dilayan dengan hormat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该宣传活动强调，麻风病可以治愈，患者应受到尊重。
dual_scenarios.en: The awareness campaign stresses that leprosy is curable and that patients should be treated with respect.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Aku dah baca kat laman WHO, kusta boleh sembuh dengan rawatan yang betul.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Saya sudah membaca di laman WHO bahawa kusta boleh disembuhkan dengan rawatan yang betul.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我看过世卫组织的网站了，麻风病接受正确治疗是能治好的。
dual_scenarios.en: I checked the WHO website. Leprosy can be cured with the right treatment.
spoken_features: sembuh 在口语中直接表示病人或疾病痊愈

messages.speaker: Mei (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah baca kat laman WHO, kusta boleh sembuh dengan rawatan yang betul.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah membaca di laman WHO bahawa kusta boleh disembuhkan dengan rawatan yang betul.
messages.zh: 我看过世卫组织的网站了，麻风病是可以通过正确治疗治好的。
messages.en: I checked the WHO website. Leprosy can be cured with the right treatment.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Oh, aku baru tahu. Janganlah kita sisihkan pesakit sebab takut je.
messages.ms_standard: Oh, saya baru mengetahui perkara itu. Janganlah kita menyisihkan pesakit semata-mata kerana takut.
messages.zh: 哦，我也是刚知道。咱们别光因为害怕就排斥患者。
messages.en: Oh, I didn't know that. We shouldn't shut patients out just because we're afraid.

etymology.historical_story: Kusta belongs to Malay's Sanskrit-derived vocabulary, tracing to kuṣṭha, a historical term associated with leprosy and skin disease. The old disease name survives in present-day Malay, while its medical explanation has become more precise. Today, understanding the word also means recognising that leprosy is treatable and that affected people deserve dignity. [Historical Malay dictionary](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/6c/A_manual_of_the_Malay_language._With_an_introductory_sketch_of_the_Sanskrit_element_in_Malay_%28IA_manualofmalaylan00maxwrich%29.pdf)；[WHO](https://www.who.int/en/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/leprosy)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: kus.ta 两拍联想“关注皮肤，也关注神经”，把病名与主要受影响部位连起来；不要只记住外观损伤。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 使用 pesakit kusta 或 individu yang mengalami kusta，以人为先。避免把疾病名称当作人的绰号、辱骂或表示嫌弃的比喻。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于医疗、公共卫生及相关历史讨论。疾病可治愈，也不会通过握手、拥抱或一起吃饭等普通接触传播；交流时避免制造恐惧或排斥。[WHO：Leprosy](https://www.who.int/en/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/leprosy)
